description: This file contains C# source code defining two classes, CollectionTestGrain and ReentrantCollectionTestGrain, which are Orleans grains used for testing collection behaviors and reentrancy in a distributed actor system. It includes methods for lifecycle management, counters, timers, and inter-grain communication.

classes.name: CollectionTestGrain
classes.description: An Orleans grain class used for testing collection behaviors, including activation, deactivation, counters, timers, and inter-grain references.

classes.name: ReentrantCollectionTestGrain
classes.description: A subclass of CollectionTestGrain with reentrant capabilities, used for testing reentrancy in Orleans grains.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Handles grain activation, initializes logger and counters.

methods.name: IncrCounter
methods.description: Increments both static and instance counters, logs the operation.

methods.name: GetAge
methods.description: Returns the age of the grain since activation.

methods.name: SetOther
methods.description: Sets a reference to another grain.

methods.name: GetOtherAge
methods.description: Gets the age of the 'other' grain.

methods.name: GetGrainReference
methods.description: Returns a reference to this grain.

methods.name: StartTimer
methods.description: Starts a timer with specified period and delay.

methods.name: TimerCallback
methods.description: Callback method for the timer, increments counters and logs.
